classes.name: Triptans
classes.description: Acute migraine 5-HT1B/1D agonists: sumatriptan (tablet, nasal, injection; Imitrex, Tosymra, Zembrace), rizatriptan (Maxalt, MLT), zolmitriptan (Zomig), eletriptan (Relpax), naratriptan, almotriptan, frovatriptan, sumatriptan/naproxen (Treximet).
classes.plainDescription: A pill (or spray/shot) taken when a migraine starts.

classes.name: Acute CGRP antagonists (gepants) & ditans
classes.description: Acute CGRP receptor antagonists and ditans: rimegepant (Nurtec ODT, also preventive), ubrogepant (Ubrelvy), zavegepant nasal (Zavzpret), lasmiditan (Reyvow).
classes.plainDescription: A newer migraine pill (or nasal spray) for when triptans don't work or aren't safe.

classes.name: CGRP preventives
classes.description: Migraine-preventive CGRP agents: erenumab (Aimovig), fremanezumab (Ajovy), galcanezumab (Emgality), eptinezumab (Vyepti, IV), atogepant (Qulipta, oral).
classes.plainDescription: A monthly shot (or daily pill) that prevents migraines.

paRequired.reason: PA required (listed on the preferred side with PA flag, p.39)
criteria: Prescribed by or in consultation with a neurologist or UCNS-certified headache specialist.
Migraine with or without aura confirmed per current International Headache Society classification; baseline migraine and headache days per month documented.
Averaged four or more migraine days per month over the previous three months.
Failure of at least one preventive from beta-blockers, antidepressants, or anticonvulsants, OR a contraindication or intolerance that prohibits such a trial.
Gepant for prevention: failure, contraindication, or intolerance to at least two preferred CGRP mAbs; a non-preferred gepant also needs the same for the preferred gepants.
Other non-preferred preventive: failure, contraindication, or intolerance to the preferred migraine prevention agents for the diagnosis.
If currently on another migraine preventive: will discontinue it first, or a medical reason for concomitant use supported by literature or guidelines.
